filterType.description: A string indicating the type of filter applied. Valid value is 'CRM_OBJECT_PROPERTY'.

operator.description: A string specifying the operation used for comparison. Valid values include 'EQ', 'N_EQ', 'LT', 'GT', 'LTE', 'GTE', 'CONTAINS', 'STARTS_WITH', 'ENDS_WITH', 'IN', 'NOT_IN', 'IS_EMPTY', and 'IS_NOT_EMPTY'.

property.description: A string representing the property name that the condition is evaluating.

value.description: A string representing the value to compare against the specified property using the defined operator.

values.description: An array of strings containing multiple values for comparison when using operators like 'IN' or 'NOT_IN'.

snapshotRequests.description: An array of CrmObjectSnapshotRequest objects, each representing a request to create a snapshot for a specific CRM object. This property is required.

snapshotResponses.description: An array of responses for each CRM object snapshot request. Each item in the array is a CrmObjectSnapshotResponse object, detailing the outcome of a single snapshot request.

objectId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier of the CRM object.

objectTypeId.description: A string representing the type identifier of the CRM object.

portalId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier of the HubSpot portal.

objectTypeId.description: A string representing the type identifier of the CRM object involved in the snapshot.

portalId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier of the HubSpot portal associated with the CRM object snapshot. It is in int64 format.

snapshotStatusId.description: A string in UUID format representing the status identifier of the snapshot operation.

context.description: Context about the error condition, represented as an object with additional properties.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for the request. Include this value with any error reports or support tickets.

errors.description: Further information about the error, represented as an array of ErrorDetail objects.

links.description: A map of link names to associated URIs containing documentation about the error or recommended remediation steps.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate.

example.message: Invalid input (details will vary based on the error)

in.description: The name of the field or parameter in which the error was found.

conditions.description: An array of conditions that define the criteria for the filter. Each condition specifies a filter type, operator, property, and optional values.

Filter.description: Defines a single condition for searching CRM objects, specifying the property to filter on, the operator to use (such as equals, greater than, or contains), and the value(s) to compare against.

subscriptionId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier of the subscription to which the filter will be applied. It is required and uses the int64 format.

filterId.description: The unique identifier for the created filter. It is an integer in int64 format.

createdAt.description: A Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when the filter was created.

id.description: The unique identifier for the filter, represented as a 64-bit integer.

currentOffset.description: A UUID string indicating the current offset for pagination purposes.

expiresAt.description: The date and time when the URL will expire, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: A string representing the URL where the journal data can be accessed.

completedAt.description: The timestamp when the snapshot was completed, represented as an integer in int64 format. This field may be null if the snapshot is not yet completed.

errorCode.description: An optional code indicating the error that occurred, if any. Possible values are 'TIMEOUT', 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'INTERNAL_ERROR', and 'PERMISSION_DENIED'.

id.description: A unique identifier for the snapshot, represented as a UUID.

initiatedAt.description: The timestamp when the snapshot was initiated, represented as an integer in int64 format.

message.description: A descriptive message providing additional information about the snapshot status or error.

category.description: A string indicating the category of the error.

actionOverrides.description: An object containing overrides for actions, where each key is an action and the value is an ActionOverrideRequest object.

actions.description: An array of actions associated with the subscription. Valid actions include 'CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'MERGE', 'RESTORE', 'ASSOCIATION_ADDED', 'ASSOCIATION_REMOVED', 'SNAPSHOT', 'APP_INSTALL', 'APP_UNINSTALL', 'ADDED_TO_LIST', 'REMOVED_FROM_LIST', and 'GDPR_DELETE'.

appId.description: The unique identifier for the app associated with the subscription, represented as an integer.

associatedObjectTypeIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of associated object types.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the subscription was created, in ISO 8601 format.

createdBy.description: The unique identifier of the user who created the subscription, represented as an integer.

deletedAt.description: The date and time when the subscription was deleted, in ISO 8601 format, if applicable.

id.description: The unique identifier for the subscription, represented as an integer.

listIds.description: An array of integers representing the IDs of lists associated with the subscription.

objectIds.description: An array of integers representing the IDs of objects associated with the subscription.

objectTypeId.description: The identifier for the type of object associated with the subscription, represented as a string.

portalId.description: The unique identifier for the portal associated with the subscription, represented as an integer.

properties.description: An array of strings representing the properties associated with the subscription.

subscriptionType.description: The type of subscription, indicating the nature of events it pertains to. Valid values include 'OBJECT', 'ASSOCIATION', 'EVENT', 'APP_LIFECYCLE_EVENT', 'LIST_MEMBERSHIP', and 'GDPR_PRIVACY_DELETION'.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the subscription was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
